items.title: Ralph Humphrey interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: But the next tier was the Richard Stone group... And so we would do two, three sessions a week... we would just whip through that stuff

ctx.x: What kind of — who were the people that were writing the scores for those cartoons?
The main guy was — well before Richard Stone it was the gentleman who wrote all the Tiny Toon stuff, and why can’t I think of his name right now. He’s a film score — I’ll think of it in a minute.
